tools.name: rtk
tools.notes: Token-optimized command proxy. Router rewrites grep/find/cat through rtk; rtk rewrite exit-code protocol (0/1/2/3) is version-coupled.

tools.name: jcodemunch
tools.notes: Indexed code search MCP server. Powers scout agent, router fallback, and Step 2.5 divert; wheel-URL uvx installs are supported transports.

tools.name: graphify
tools.notes: Knowledge graph builder. PyPI package name is graphifyy; repo moved to Graphify-Labs (safishamsi redirects); version-warns outside tested range. 0.9.51 writes no .rebuild.lock, and its shrink guard keeps a partial build from overwriting graph.json.

tools.name: headroom
tools.notes: Context-compression proxy. Repo moved to headroomlabs-ai (chopratejas redirects); detected via headroom-init-claude hook marker or localhost ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL; /savings reads `headroom perf --format json`.

tools.name: superpowers
tools.notes: Base skills framework (required). Detected via ~/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json; every chain skill wraps a superpowers:* skill.
